title: Good idea!
body:
Feature Suggestion: Completed To-Dos History

Hello Habitica team and community! 👋

I would like to suggest adding a “Completed To-Dos History” feature to Habitica.

🔹 What is it?

A section or tab where users can view their completed To-Dos, showing the task name, completion date, and rewards earned (XP and gold).

🔹 Why is it useful?
	•	Helps users track and reflect on what they’ve accomplished.
	•	Useful for reusing or reactivating important tasks from the past.
	•	Motivates users by showing their progress and efforts.
	•	Could assist with productivity reviews or personal analytics.

🔹 Bonus Ideas (Optional Features):
	•	Filters by date, difficulty, or tags.
	•	Option to restore a completed To-Do as a new task.
	•	List or calendar view of completed To-Dos.

Thanks for considering this! I believe it would really improve the experience and sense of accomplishment in Habitica. 🗒️✨

title: No se puede usar offline
body:
Sería mi app de hábitos favorita, si tan solo se pudiera usar sin internet... varias veces la he usado y luego desinstalado por esta razón.
De resto es genial. La más completa y divertida. Bueno, no tiene la complejodad de todoist o TickTick y esas, pero para listas y hábitos realmente es buenísima. Ojalá no requiriera internet cada vez
